items.independent_value: 48 eligible finds: 13 wholly within 419.62–426.7 Ma, 32 wholly younger, and three crossing 419.62 Ma.
items.file_value: 48 eligible; 13 wholly within the older interval.
items.note: Applied the specified B2/main and age-range filters directly. The 13 also form six distinct region-and-age-range groups.

items.independent_value: Correct conditional on n independent finds drawn with density proportional to x: P(no early find | n)=[I_later/(I_later+I_early)]^n=(1+E/n)^(−n).
items.file_value: P(no early find)=(1+E/n)^(−n), needing no level later rate.
items.note: Requires E=nI_early/I_later and nonzero I_later. E is the early expectation obtained by fitting intensity to the later count; the conditional expected early count given total n is instead E/(1+E/n).

items.quantity: Zero support in the rock measure
items.independent_value: Rock is identically zero throughout 420.39–426.7 Ma: 6.31 Myr immediately younger than A; Gorstian and Ludfordian stage means are zero. Hirnantian is also zero.
items.file_value: The stage table reports zero rock for Hirnantian, Gorstian and Ludfordian.
items.note: This is database coverage under the selected geography and environmental classification, not evidence of globally absent terrestrial rock or finding opportunities.

items.independent_value: The true older count can be 13–16. Level tails range from 0.207925 to 0.036334; searching tails from 0.193822 to 0.032409.
items.file_value: C59 says level and searching fit the placement; main.md says the later finds follow them.
items.note: Thirteen is a guaranteed minimum. Its upper-tail calculation supports conservative rejection of rock, spores and their product, under independent proportional sampling and valid age intervals. Non-rejection at that minimum does not establish fit for level or searching.

items.quantity: Probability interpretation of multiplied single ratios
items.independent_value: Only the ratio of pointwise-product means directly supplies I_later/I_early for finding proportional to rock × spores or searching × spores.
items.file_value: Both forms receive E, p_no_early_find and fits/exceeds columns.
items.note: The multiplied-ratio calculations are algebraically reproduced, but their probabilities require a separate model. Product-means Q divided by multiplied-ratios Q is 1.27977/1.31348 for rock and 0.92796/0.89512 for searching at 444/452 Ma.

items.independent_value: Weak stage-rank correlation does not demonstrate independent mechanisms or validate multiplying the proxies.
items.file_value: C59 labels the combination post hoc, without a confidence level, and acknowledges shared causes and geographical mismatch.
items.note: Those qualifications are necessary. The permutation test assumes exchangeable stage labels; temporal dependence weakens its interpretation. North American rock and global spore/searching measures do not establish proportional sampling of the global fossil inventory.

items.independent_value: 419.62–426.7 Ma spans Gorstian–Pridoli. Literal Ludfordian–Pridoli is 419.62–425 Ma; the same 13 finds then give level expected=7.771291, p=0.038191, and searching expected=7.832102, p=0.040365.
items.file_value: The specified interval and placement output are labelled Ludfordian–Pridoli.
items.note:
The numerical checks above use the requested interval, but its label is incorrect and the claimed fit depends on the interval chosen. All calculations ran in memory without importing either production script; no repository files were written.
